voice.continueLine: Olives. One coin. I am not discussing it.
voice.selectLine: Napkin. The possum found me folded. I am still a little folded.
tauntLines: The mop has seen worse than you.
I do not talk much. The mop talks.
voice.endingText: Napkin mopped the whole sewer after the credits. It took four days. It is still wet.

parodyMeta.bootlegOf: the big quiet member of a four-reptile sewer ninja team, a long-reach powerhouse who fights with a mop
parodyMeta.gag: Named after what the sensei found in a dumpster; he folds himself into a corner when embarrassed, and he wants olives on everything
tells: Wears a paper napkin folded into a headband instead of any kind of mask, re-folded every time it tears
